newsitem.title: USA: FIGURE SKATING-DEFENDING CHAMPIONS LEAD DANCE AT U.S. NATIONALS.
newsitem.headline: FIGURE SKATING-DEFENDING CHAMPIONS LEAD DANCE AT U.S. NATIONALS.

text.p: Defending champions Elizabeth Punsalan and Jerod Swalow took the lead in the Dance competition after two compulsory dances at the U.S. Figure Skating Championships on Tuesday.
Last year's bronze medalists Eve Chalom and Mathew Gates were second after skating the Rumba and the Golden Waltz. Kate Robinson and Peter Breen were third.
"We're all headed in the right direction," Chalom said about the club's showing.
"It is unforgiving," said Swalow about the Golden Waltz. "Having skated it in three internationals gave us a lot more confidence."
The Golden Waltz was designed by Russian dance guru, Natalia Dubova, who has coached several Russian teams to Olympic gold medals.
"I'm so proud of the new generation of dancers and how the dance improves their technique," Dubova said. "It requires many tight turns."
